description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST 'xid' equals the originating DISCOVER's 'xid' (RFC 2131 §4.4.1 MUST). The harness server emul faithfully echoes DISCOVER.xid in OFFER, so REQUEST.xid == OFFER.xid is verified against the snapshot
approach:
[Objective]
The transaction id ties the DISCOVER → OFFER → REQUEST chain together. RFC 2131 §4.4.1 requires REQUEST.xid to equal the OFFER.xid (which itself echoes DISCOVER.xid). A different xid would orphan the REQUEST.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER (xid = X) → harness snapshots X
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER (xid = X)
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • xid == X   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST.xid equals the snapshotted DISCOVER.xid.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_xid_mismatch — REQUEST carries a different xid (transaction tracking broken)
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — corresponding frame missing

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
